claims.mechanism: At 1:0, ر ح م B001 tenderness, B002 kinship, and especially B003 womb imagery supply a protected spatial enclosure for dependent formation. ر ب ب B002 stagewise nurture in 1:2, repeated mercy in 1:3, ع و ن B001 aid in 1:5, and ه د ي B001 guidance in 1:6 unfold as growth within that enclosure; the eleven-ayah formulation adds the compatible causal layer that protective mercy enables the development it surrounds.

At 1:0, the doubled ر ح م B001/B002/B003 mercy precedes and encloses the م ل ك B003 dominion and د ي ن B002 reckoning activated in 1:4. This sequence carries tenderness into the legal-sovereign scene, framing rather than canceling judgment and recompense.

At 1:0, س م و B005 functions sequentially as the first road-sign or banner: the raised designation is placed before the ص ر ط B001 path is requested in 1:6-1:7, making the name an orienting marker rather than a static designation.

At 1:0, س م و B005 and ء ل ه B001/B002 make invocation of the raised divine name an enacted alignment with an addressee. The later direct address, ع ب د B003 worship, and ع و ن B001 help-seeking in 1:5 disclose the practical relation established before any demand, placing the ensuing praise, service, aid, and guidance under the named agent rather than leaving the basmalah a detached label or formula.

At 1:0, the س م و elevation and designation material in B001/B005/B008 makes naming a raising of the invoked agent's public mention. Later ح م د B001/B003 praise and praiseworthy naming in 1:2, together with recurrence of the mercy names in 1:3, enact or socially confirm that elevation and spread, so بسم begins an ongoing raising of mention rather than mere reference.

source_findings.finding_title: The opening name as a raised public marker of agency.
source_findings.claimed_branches: س م و:B005;س م و:B008;ء ل ه:B002;ح م د:B001;ح م د:B003
source_findings.source_text: 1. **The opening name as a raised public marker of agency.** Evidence: `س م و B005` name as raised designation, with `س م و B008` good repute spread; `ء ل ه B002` fixed divine name in invocation; `ح م د B001/B003` later praise and praiseworthy naming in 1:2. Mechanism: the initial “name” is not only a label but the visible elevation of the agent under whom the later acts of praise, worship, help-seeking, and guidance will occur. The packet supplies name, divine invocation, and praise; I infer the directional arrow from naming to public orientation. Abductive move: if the speech begins by raising a name, later praise becomes the social confirmation of that raised designation. Reading change: the basmalah reads less as a detachable formula and more as the banner under which the whole passage is organized.

source_findings.finding_title: Mercy as the enclosure that precedes both nurture and judgment.
source_findings.claimed_branches: ر ح م:B001;ر ح م:B002;ر ح م:B003;ر ب ب:B002;م ل ك:B003;د ي ن:B002
source_findings.source_text: 2. **Mercy as the enclosure that precedes both nurture and judgment.** Evidence: `ر ح م B001` mercy and tenderness, `ر ح م B002` kinship bond, `ر ح م B003` womb; activated by `ر ب ب B002` nurture/completion in 1:2 and by `م ل ك B003` plus `د ي ن B002` dominion and reckoning in 1:4. Mechanism: the double mercy surrounds the move from ربّ care to ملك/دين judgment, making the later legal-sovereign scene enter through an already merciful enclosure. The packet supplies mercy, nurture, dominion, and reckoning; I infer that mercy frames rather than cancels judgment. Abductive move: a sequence that names mercy before ownership of reckoning asks the reader to carry tenderness into the tribunal. Reading change: “الرحمن الرحيم” becomes a governing atmosphere for the whole surah, not only a pair of attributes.

source_findings.claimed_branches: ء ل ه:B001;ء ل ه:B002;ع ب د:B003;ع و ن:B001
source_findings.source_text: 3. **Invocation as relation before demand.** Evidence: `ء ل ه B001` worship and the worshipped one, `ء ل ه B002` invocation formula, `ع ب د B003` worship/submissive obedience in 1:5, `ع و ن B001` help/backing in 1:5. Mechanism: the opening invocation establishes the addressee before the “You alone” repetition appears; worship and help-seeking are later disclosed as the practical shape of the name invoked here. The packet supplies the divine name and later direct address; I infer that the name authorizes the later second-person turn. Abductive move: one invokes a name before asking because the relation must be recognized before dependence is voiced. Reading change: the basmalah becomes a relational threshold into petition, not merely a pious preface.

source_findings.finding_title: The opening name becomes the first road-sign or banner.

source_findings.source_text: The later path material in 1:6–1:7 made `س م و B005` feel more like a road-sign or banner than a static “name”: the name is the first marker before any صراط is requested. The sharper surprise came from 1:4: mercy is not simply soft affect, because ملك/دين activates a scene of ownership, reckoning, and recompense inside the already-named mercy.

source_findings.finding_title: The name as a performative point of entry.
source_findings.claimed_branches: س م و:B005;ء ل ه:B002;ء ل ه:B001
source_findings.source_text: 1. **The name as a performative point of entry.** **Branch evidence:** the fixed `بِسْمِ` carries `س م و` B005, “name as raised designation,” while fixed `ٱللَّهِ` carries `ء ل ه` B002, the fixed divine name in invocation, and B001, the worshipped one. **Structural cue:** the prefixed `بـ` attaches the opening to the name; `الله` then receives praise in 1:2, and the twice-fronted `إِيَّاكَ` in 1:5 turns designation into exclusive direct address. **Role and abductive move:** the packet supplies naming, repetition, and the shift to address; I infer that beginning by the name places the ensuing praise, service, request for aid, and request for guidance under that named addressee. **Reading change:** the phrase is not merely identification but an enacted alignment that initiates the surah’s speech.

source_findings.finding_title: Naming as the raising of mention.
source_findings.claimed_branches: س م و:B001;س م و:B008;ح م د:B001
source_findings.source_text: 2. **Naming as the raising of mention.** **Branch evidence:** fixed `س م و` B001 includes figurative elevation and raised mention, and B008 gives good repute spreading; 1:2 `ح م د` B001 supplies praise and commendation. **Structural cue:** `اسم` comes first, then praise follows, and the two fixed mercy names recur exactly in 1:3. **Role and abductive move:** praise and recurrence are packet facts; I supply the arrow that they actualize the root’s elevation image by making the designation repeatedly heard and commended. **Reading change:** `بسم` begins a process of raising the named one’s mention, not just referring to him.

source_findings.claimed_branches: ر ح م:B001;ر ح م:B003;ر ب ب:B002;ع و ن:B001;ه د ي:B001
source_findings.source_text: 3. **Mercy as a formative enclosure.** **Branch evidence:** the two fixed `ر ح م` forms retain B001, tenderness and beneficence, but also activate B003, the womb as a protected place of growth. **Structural cue:** 1:2 `ر ب ب` B002 describes nurture and completion stage by stage, the mercy pair is repeated in 1:3, and 1:5–1:6 move to aid and guidance. **Role and abductive move:** the womb branch supplies the spatial model and later nurture, aid, and guidance supply the dependent’s development; I infer that protective mercy enables that development rather than merely accompanying it. **Reading change:** the doubled attributes can be heard as sustained, generative shelter within which the addressed dependents are formed and led.

source_findings.finding_title: The opening name develops into an exclusive addressee.
source_findings.notes: Atomic split from the retrospective paragraph. Agent-orchestrated normalization: merged.
source_findings.source_text: 1:5 supplied the strongest later correction: its twice-fronted `إياك` shows that the opening fixed name develops into an exclusive addressee, so the invocation cannot remain a detached label. The combination of 1:2’s stagewise `رب` nurture, 1:3’s exact mercy repetition, and 1:6’s guidance also made the womb branch of fixed `ر ح م` newly functional as an enabling enclosure rather than a decorative association.

variants.scope_en: It includes huda and hidayah as right guidance, indication, clarification, showing the road, truth, or religion, becoming guided, divine enabling, and accepting guidance

syntax_edges.reason: سْمِ is governed by the prefixed بِ in the formula بِسْمِ.
ٱللَّهِ is the genitive muḍāf ilayhi of سْمِ.
ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ follows ٱللَّهِ in genitive definiteness as an adjectival divine epithet.
ٱلرَّحِيمِ follows ٱللَّهِ in the same genitive adjectival series.
ٱللَّهِ is governed by لِ, and the prepositional phrase لِلَّهِ completes the predicate relation with ٱلْحَمْدُ.
لِلَّهِ is the khabar of ٱلْحَمْدُ in the nominal sentence.
رَبِّ is genitive and stands in apposition to ٱللَّهِ.
ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ is the genitive muḍāf ilayhi of رَبِّ.
ٱلرَّحِيمِ follows ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ as a paired genitive divine epithet within the ayah.
يَوْمِ is the genitive complement of مَٰلِكِ in an iḍāfa construction.
ٱلدِّينِ is the genitive muḍāf ilayhi of يَوْمِ.
إِيَّاكَ is the fronted explicit object of نَعْبُدُ.
إِيَّاكَ is the fronted explicit object of نَسْتَعِينُ.
نَسْتَعِينُ is coordinated with نَعْبُدُ by وَ in the parallel construction.
The نَا suffix in ٱهْدِنَا is the first-person plural object of ٱهْدِ.
ٱلصِّرَٰطَ is the explicit accusative object governed by ٱهْدِنَا.
ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ agrees with ٱلصِّرَٰطَ and qualifies it.
ٱلَّذِينَ is the genitive complement of صِرَٰطَ in iḍāfa.

linguistic_context.cooccurrence_caveat: These are mechanical intra-ayah root co-occurrences with corpus counts, not semantic collocation judgments.
